name: meatball
description: Jesse's Claude Code mods: the meatball status buddy.

plugins.name: meatball
plugins.description: A pixel-art meatball above the prompt, in the desktop app and the terminal, that shows what Claude is doing: rolls while it works, chomps on edits, watches commands, winces at errors, waits on you, hops when done, dozes when idle, and gets rounder as the context fills.
